collection.limits: Two sequential 4096-hanchan runs per implementation, in baseline/candidate then candidate/baseline order, each with 256 warmup. Pooled speed is total completed work divided by total measured seconds, and does not include previous experiments. Same input checkpoints and collection configuration; asynchronous branch counts can differ. Collection timing includes compressed persistence and writer drain, excludes model load, warmup and post-run decode. Device-wide VRAM and process RSS cover the entire process at 50 ms intervals; initial device usage differs between runs. Two runs at one seed do not establish statistical equivalence, a causal speed regression or playing strength.

baseline.timingScope: Measured collection includes feature encoding, all inference and engine work, GRP, branch completion, and optional compressed match persistence including writer drain. Games count actual hanchan completions; hands and LCFR trajectories are separate. Completed decisions count all retained main-game choices, including forced choices; branch work is reported separately. Model load, warmup and post-run observation shape decoding are excluded. The game budget uses the same hanchan unit as Nano, but CFR retains all four seats instead of Nano's learner seat. CollectorStats elapsedSeconds excludes the final writer drain; headline elapsedSeconds includes it.
